name: Grande Clip (company builder founded by Kim Bong-jin, private)
note: Company builder founded by Woowa Brothers (Baedal Minjok) founder and former chairman Kim Bong-jin. In September 2024 a Grande Clip-led consortium with Altos Ventures completed the acquisition of AMCR, operator of the AmazingCre golfwear brand (Venturesquare, 2024-09-10).
